documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported a robust financial performance for H1 FY26, with revenue growing by 49.08% year-on-year to Rs. 78.77 crores. The company is expanding its product portfolio by launching a new business vertical for puja and devotional products in January, alongside its recently launched Oil and Soya Chunks segments. Management is focusing on deeper market penetration in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana while planning for capacity expansions and potential export market entry in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects H2 to perform better than H1, particularly driven by the newly launched Oil segment.
guidance.quote: So, H2 will be better in the Oil. So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain a growth rate that is better than its past three years.
guidance.quote: But the growth will be maintained as the past growth will be maintained better than that.

guidance.claim: The company targets its yearly advertising spend to be below 1% of its revenues.
guidance.quote: overall yearly we plan, our revenues we are targeting with 1% only, not even 1%, below 1% it will be.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 to be the best year in its complete history.
guidance.quote: But it will be better than, FY '27 will be the best in our past complete history.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees huge market potential for its newly launched products.
demand_outlook.quote: And if you see the current market, the market is a huge market potential.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that there are very few brands competing in the pure groundnut oil segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Very less brands are there in the pure groundnut oil.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles, devotional goods, and festival related items.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to install a manufacturing plant for Soya Chunks after two quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: After one shield kit, just standard shields, we will go for the plant. Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand its capacity for Atta and Spices after the next financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Within 2 years, we have to plan. It will take some time. After the next financial year, we have to go for the expansion plan.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand into export markets like the Middle East, Singapore, and the US in FY27.

margins_costs.claim: The company delivered an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and a PAT margin of 9.14% for H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: The company currently spends Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 lakhs monthly on media channels for advertising.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: The company's margins in the Oil segment are currently minimal as it is in the initial launch phase.
margins_costs.quote: So, once we cater into the market and once people understand about the quality and all, like soon the margins will be better. But initially it will be like minimal only.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 3,600 tons for Spices and utilized 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's short-term borrowings increased due to an overdraft that came on the last day of September.
capital_allocation.quote: Actually, mainly there was one OD came on the last day of September. So, that contributed so much towards short-term borrowings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to utilize debt from bankers if funding is needed for expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: We will be going for the debt as of now. If we need exactly, we will go for the debts of the bankers.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains focused on operational efficiency and working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: We remain focused on operational efficiency and working capital management and strengthening our market presence.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is facing a tough time and slower revenue speed in Maharashtra due to established brands.
risks_headwinds.quote: Even we are expanding the geographical also, but as we launched in the Maharashtra, so we are having a very tough time in the Maharashtra. So, we are not getting that much of revenue speed, what we wanted.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted that geographical expansion is tough and can dent profitability and network building.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because when we go for the placement of the new product in a new region, it will be quite tough. It will take at least a year to get the proper placement also. So, it will dent our profitability as well as the network also, to build the network.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch its new devotional product vertical in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to utilize almost 30% of its Oil capacity in H2.
management_commitments.quote: I think next financial year, H2 will be utilized almost 30% easily. We can reach up to 30%. Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its capacity for Atta and Spices within 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Within 2 years, we have to plan.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand into export markets in FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
